visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at night on a city street, focusing on a metal street food cart under a bright overhead lamp. A woman wearing a pink t-shirt and a face mask stands behind the counter alongside a man in a dark shirt. The background is a dimly lit urban alleyway with parked motorcycles and buildings. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of a grill where various skewers of meat and fish cakes are being cooked. A hand uses a brush to apply a dark, glossy sauce over the skewers, which are sizzling. (3) The woman in the pink shirt hands a plastic bag filled with skewers toward the camera, her eyes smiling behind the mask. (4) A close-up shows a hand holding a skewer with grilled meat and fish cakes inside a paper bag, showcasing the texture. (5) The shot transitions to a wide display of various raw skewers in plastic bags and red bowls on the stall's counter, ready for selection. (6) Back on the grill, a hand is seen vigorously brushing sauce and then shaking a seasoning bottle over skewers of green beans and meat, with smoke rising. (7) A montage follows, featuring different individual skewers—chicken wings, round fish cakes, meat with scallions, and green beans—held up against a blurred night street background. (8) Finally, the woman is seen again at the stall, preparing an order and smiling at the camera as the video ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To recommend a popular, long-standing nameless BBQ stall in Kaohsiung. The video highlights the stall's 20-year history, the long waiting times as a testament to its quality, and provides specific food recommendations like chicken wings and fish cakes to entice viewers to visit and 'save' the location for their next late-night snack.
